name: Thebacon
summary: Thebacon (INN; pronounced ), or dihydrocodeinone enol acetate, is a semisynthetic opioid that is similar to hydrocodone and is most commonly synthesised from thebaine. Thebacon was invented in Germany in 1924, four years after the first synthesis of hydrocodone. Thebacon is a derivative of acetyldihydrocodeine, where only the 6–7 double bond is saturated.

uses.text: Thebacon is an opioid agonist narcotic analgesic of the middle range and a strong antitussive, primarily used in Europe, although it is no longer in common use. Currently, dihydrocodeine and nicocodeine are used as second-line codeine replacements.

pharmacology.en: It is the enol acetate of hydrocodone and is converted in the body into hydrocodone and related compounds. It acts mainly by switching on mu opioid receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 它是氫可酮的烯醇乙酸酯，在體內會轉換成氫可酮及相關化合物，主要透過活化μ鴉片受體產生作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是氢可酮的烯醇乙酸酯，在体内会转换成氢可酮及相关化合物，主要通过活化μ鸦片受体产生作用。

sideEffects.en: Drugs that switch on the mu opioid receptor can cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and in overdose they slow breathing, which can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 會活化μ鴉片受體的藥物可能造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，過量時會抑制呼吸，可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 会活化μ鸦片受体的药物可能造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，过量时会抑制呼吸，可能致命。

fact.en: Thebacon was invented in Germany in 1924, four years after hydrocodone, and was sold under the name Acedicon. It is usually made from thebaine.
fact.zh: 醋氫可酮在1924年於德國發明，比氫可酮晚了四年，曾以Acedicon之名販售。它通常以蒂巴因為原料製成。
fact.zhHans: 醋氢可酮在1924年于德国发明，比氢可酮晚了四年，曾以Acedicon之名贩售。它通常以蒂巴因为原料制成。
